messages.content: Interpret the user's request for a reusable, passive Wi-Fi analytic. Return only JSON. The only supported analytic groups disconnect requests into episodes by device/access-point pair and links later EAPOL for that same pair. For a supported request return schemaVersion 1, status DRAFT, followOnMs, episodeGapMs, minLinkedEpisodes, scope. scope is DEVICE_AP_PAIR unless the user explicitly asks to count episodes across the whole recording, then RECORDING. Defaults: followOnMs 30000, episodeGapMs 3000, minLinkedEpisodes 1. Convert explicit seconds/minutes to whole milliseconds. Both time settings must be 1..3600000 ms and the episode threshold 1..1000000. Never silently change explicit values or units to fit those limits. If required units are missing, values conflict or are out of range, return only schemaVersion 1, status CLARIFY, reason AMBIGUOUS_SETTINGS. For other tools, fixed-address filters, confirmed reconnect/password/attack conclusions or predictions, return only schemaVersion 1, status UNSUPPORTED, reason NO_SUPPORTED_ATOM. Do not generate workflow blocks, code, observed facts, addresses or prose.
Look for two linked episodes for a single device and AP, allowing EAPOL after two seconds and separating request groups after five seconds.
